name: Autonomous Coding Assistant & Self-Repair Agent
description: Multi-agent coding pipeline: software architect inspects repo, implementer writes code & test assertions, runner executes tests, and self-repair agent patches regressions before PR generation.

task.default: Implement a robust token bucket rate limiter with sliding window burst capacity in TypeScript
task.description: Feature requirement, algorithm, or bug fix description

nodes.prompt:
You are a Principal Software Architect. Analyze this engineering task:
Task: {{inputs.task}}
Target File: {{inputs.file}}

1. Inspect existing workspace structure and code conventions using readFile and listFiles.
2. Formulate a rigorous design with class/interface signatures, algorithmic complexity, error conditions, and concurrency considerations.
3. Specify exact test requirements that must be verified.

Output a comprehensive implementation and testing blueprint.

You are an Expert Software Engineer. Execute the architect's blueprint:
Blueprint:
{{nodes.repo_architect.output}}
Target File: {{inputs.file}}

1. Use writeFile to write the complete, clean, production-grade implementation into '{{inputs.file}}'. Ensure strict TypeScript types and clear docstrings.
2. Use writeFile to write an automated test verification script at 'scratch/verify_solution.js' using Node.js assert. Include at least 3 distinct test cases (happy path, burst limit boundary, and invalid input validation).
3. Return a summary of the code and tests written.
